Chapter 361: Chapter 16 The Confused Ancestral Demon Tree (Please Subscribe)

In fact, Lin Yuan had overestimated the Ancestral Demon Tree.

The Foreign Evil God didn’t have the boldness to ‘cut off its own flesh’ and leave; it had completely lost its composure and pinned all its hopes on Lin Yuan.

Therefore.

When Lin Yuan actively contacted the Ancestral Demon Tree, pretending to have grown to the Fifth Stage,

The joy in the heart of the Ancestral Demon Tree was imaginable.

“Opportunity.”

...

“The opportunity I’ve been waiting for has finally come….”

Outside the Tianqing World, in a shadowy expanse of the void, the Ancestral Demon Tree stared intently at the vast world in the distance, as if looking at a delicious cake.

After destroying the Evil God Battlefield, the Tianqing Alliance Leader deliberately left the World Sword behind to prevent a counterattack from the Ancestral Demon Tree.

In reality, such a move was completely unnecessary, as the current Ancestral Demon Tree retained only fifty percent of its Origin Source from its heyday, and after losing the invasion battlefield, it simply had no power to threaten the Tianqing World.

“Who would have thought, the seed I planted back then would become the key to my descent into the Tianqing World…” mused the Ancestral Demon Tree, pleased with itself.

All along, it never once considered that Lin Yuan might deceive it. As an offspring derived from the progenitor, the former has an almost instinctual loyalty to the latter.

“Tianqing Alliance Leader and those people, they didn’t notice you after they returned, did they?” the Ancestral Demon Tree asked.

“Ancestor, the Black Mist Mountain Range where I hide is inconspicuous among the top ten mountain ranges and has not attracted any attention,”

Lin Yuan said evenly, without a blush or a skipped heartbeat.

“That’s good.”

The Ancestral Demon Tree nodded.

It thought the same; if Lin Yuan had indeed attracted the attention of powerhouses like the Tianqing Alliance Leader, how could he still contact it?

“Now start making preparations,”

“In three days, we will officially open the space channel.”

After giving a few instructions, the Ancestral Demon Tree cut off contact.

The reason for waiting three days before opening the space channel was entirely the Ancestral Demon Tree’s own plan.

Its form was too large now, though compared to the entire Tianqing World, it was inconspicuous.

But descending into the Tianqing World with such a massive size would draw attention no matter what.

And such a huge body put pressure on the space channel.

So over these three days, the Ancestral Demon Tree intended to condense its form and shrink to within a hundred meters.

Only by doing so, could it possibly hide itself after passing through the space channel and buy enough time to assimilate into the World Origin Source.

“As long as I can devour the entire Origin Source of the Tianqing World, it’s all worth it,” the Ancestral Demon Tree thought to itself, finding the process of compressing its form excruciatingly painful.

And it would certainly affect its combat power.

Amongst the void beyond realms, the bodies of Evil Gods measure millions to tens of millions of miles—are they just for show?

A large size, although it reduces agility, brings many benefits in other areas.

The most obvious is the ability to survive.

An Evil God with a millions of miles long body, compared to one that’s tens of thousands of miles long, who gains more energy from a single breath?

Naturally, it is the former.

And in the Outer Void, the ability to survive is crucial; even the Evil Gods spend most of their lives drifting alone through the void.

Encountering other Evil Gods or a World is an extremely rare event.

That’s why the Ancestral Demon Tree is so eager to descend into the Tianqing World.

Such an opportunity is too rare,

It’s enough to propel an Evil God even further.

…

Black Mist Mountain Range.

“In three days?”

Lin Yuan pondered. The Ancestral Demon Tree’s plan to open the space channel in three days was a bit unexpected.

But still within his plans.

After considering these things, Lin Yuan turned his head to look at the Tianqing Alliance Leader and the others below.

“Have you brought all the reserves over?”

Lin Yuan asked with a hint of concern.

The Tianqing World still held many reserves.

These reserves were in place to prevent extreme situations, should the Ancestral Demon Tree manage to invade the Tianqing World.

“Master, the Yin-Yang Reversal Heaven and Earth Extermination Nine Heavens Great Formation’s layout has already been set up, with sixteen Seventh-Rank Powerhouses, eighty-eight Sixth-Rank Peak Powerhouses, and one hundred ninety-four Sixth-Rank Powerhouses stationed at the key positions, leaving no margin for error,”

“Moreover, we have brought thirteen Thunder Creation Pearls.”

“These thirteen Thunder Creation Pearls are the accumulation of millions of years from our Tianqing World.”

“There will be no issues,” the Tianqing Alliance Leader declared, thumping his chest.

“That’s good.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly, content in his heart.

The ‘Yin-Yang Reversal Heaven and Earth Extermination Nine Heavens Great Formation’ mentioned by the Tianqing Alliance Leader is the most powerful formation in the Tianqing World since ancient times. If this Great Formation didn’t rely on the Tianqing World,

If it didn’t greatly lose its power once removed from the world’s range, it probably would have been taken to the Evil God Battlefield long ago.

This sort of formation could only manifest its greatest power within the world,

Powered by hundreds of powerhouses starting from the Sixth Rank, this Great Formation’s power could rise to unimaginable heights.

Even if the Ancestral Demon Tree were in its prime, if by chance it fell within the reach of this Great Formation, it would barely escape with its life, if not worse.

And the Thunder Creation Pearls?

Lin Yuan has a profound understanding of the power of these pearls,

A single Thunder Creation Pearl, when activated, would unleash a terrifying power that completely reaches the Eighth Layer level.

The Nine Heavens Thunder of the Tianqing World, after gestating for millions of years, yielded only fifteen Thunder Creation Pearls in total,

Aside from the ones previously used, the remaining thirteen Thunder Creation Pearls were brought in one fell swoop by the Tianqing Alliance Leader.
